lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.
Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naamo naam dhiaaeeai sadaa sad ihu man naame raataa he ||12||
lines.translation: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||
Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai doob mue bin neeraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaavahi naam nahee boojhahi ikanaa guramukh sabad pachhaataa he ||13||
lines.translation: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize the Word of the Shabad. ||13||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai mukat kinai na paaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naame naam milai vadiaaee sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa he ||14||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||
The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.
Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: saach salaahe saach samaavai jin guramukh eko jaataa he ||15||
lines.translation: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, and remains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare so paae ||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind,
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate nira(n)kaaree dar saachai saach pachhaataa he ||16||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realize the True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8||
Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl:
O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.
All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape gupat varatai sabh a(n)tar gur kai sabad pachhaataa he ||1||
lines.translation: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||
Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.
He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karasahi sache siu man raataa he ||2||
lines.translation: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||
You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.
In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree kar kirapaa aap pachhaataa he ||3||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Grace realizes his own self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar hovai dhur teree ||
lines.translation: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,
does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saache gun gaavai din raatee jug jug eko jaataa he ||4||
lines.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout the ages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||
Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,
from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaane se naam laage giaan matee pachhaataa he ||5||
lines.translation: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritual wisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||
The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog sabh dukh hai bhaaraa ||
lines.translation: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so sukh paae jin guramukh naam pachhaataa he ||6||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||
No one can erase the record of one's actions.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa so phal paaiaa jin aap maar pachhaataa he ||7||
lines.translation: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre-destined rewards. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi har siu chit na laagai ||
lines.translation: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.
In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bharam bhule bhekhadhaaree a(n)t kaal pachhutaataa he ||8||
lines.translation: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaanai har gun gaae ||
lines.translation: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal niramal hai baanee har setee man raataa he ||9||
lines.translation: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbued with the Lord. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare so gun nidh paae ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: gun avagan kaa eko daataa guramukh viralee jaataa he ||10||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||
My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.
God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
